AC-1.evidence: V2 analysis/routing/hypothesis modules live under src/commit_investigator/_v2_archive/ only. Active tree has analysis/{evidence_tagger,report}.py, empty hypothesis/__init__.py, no routing/. Grep of active commit_investigator/**/*.py shows zero imports from deleted V2 paths. Residual V2 surface: src/eval/forensics.py imports commit_investigator.analysis.archetype (ModuleNotFoundError on import); eval_harness.py retains full V2 D1–D6 harness stub — outside AC-1 scope but noted in findings.

AC-2.evidence: Contract-listed docs (AGENTS.md, architecture.md, temporal-model.md, evaluation.md, glossary.md, agent-loop.md, project_domain.mdc) describe V3 bug attribution as current. architecture.md and evaluation.md mention V2 only as historical pivot context. Out-of-scope docs (README.md, docs/harness.md) still describe V2 pipeline as active — not counted against AC-2.

AC-3.evidence: ProblemStatement is @dataclass(frozen=True) with title, description, project, issue_key. ProblemExtractor.from_jira_issue() maps JiraIssue fields. to_prompt_text() tested in tests/test_problem_extractor.py (201-suite green).

AC-4.evidence: GitContextProvider._enforce_bound() resolves commit SHA and uses git merge-base --is-ancestor against bound ref; raises TemporalBoundViolation on violation. get_diff/get_commit_message/get_touched_files/get_author_email all call _enforce_bound. tests/test_temporal_bound.py: test_commit_after_bound_raises, test_get_commit_message_beyond_raises all PASS.

AC-5.evidence: Four required search tools present: search_commits_by_file, search_commits_by_keyword, list_recent_commits, get_blame — all delegate to GitContextProvider methods that honor temporal_bound via git log ref or bound ref for blame. build_attribution_tools() adds 3 more (get_commit_diff, get_commit_message, get_file_at_commit). tests/test_git_search_tools.py PASS.

AC-6.evidence: AgentOrchestrator.investigate() runs multi-turn loop parsing ```tool and ```suspects blocks (_parse_tool_calls, _parse_suspects). BudgetState tracks tokens/cost/tool_calls with budget_exceeded property; loop breaks on exceed. TemporalBoundViolation caught per tool call. tests/test_attribution_agent.py: test_runs_multi_turn_investigation, test_stops_on_budget PASS.

AC-7.evidence: score_suspect_evidence() in evidence_tagger.py grades each quote via tag_hypothesis() against diff; returns SuspectEvidenceScore with grounding_rate. tests/test_evidence_scorer_v3.py covers grounded, ungrounded, mixed, no-diff cases — all PASS.

AC-8.evidence: eval_metrics.py: evaluate_attribution() computes hit_at_1/3/5, mrr, retrieval_recall, evidence_grounding_rate per case; aggregate_results() averages across cases with n=0 guard. tests/test_eval_metrics.py PASS.

AC-9.evidence: baselines.py implements git_blame_naive and file_history_recency returning BaselineResult with BugAttributionReport, tool_trace=[], metadata baseline tag. Zero LLM calls. tests/test_baselines.py PASS.

AC-10.evidence: run_eval.py select_eval_cases() line 119 calls ProblemExtractor.from_jira_issue(jira_issue) as unbound class method — TypeError: missing required arguments 'issue' and 'project' (also omits project). Verified via temp script. Correct pattern is ProblemExtractor().from_jira_issue(issue, project=project). tests/test_run_eval.py never exercises select_eval_cases() or run_eval() end-to-end, so bug is masked by unit tests. Eval runner CLI would fail at case selection.

AC-11.evidence: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/_v2_archive -v → 201 passed in 9.44s (exceeds 190+ threshold).

AC-12.evidence: ReadLints on all new/modified V3 files: no linter errors. py_compile on same file set: OK. (ruff not installed in environment.)

EC-1.evidence: tests/test_temporal_bound.py::TestTemporalBoundEnforcement::test_commit_after_bound_raises confirms TemporalBoundViolation raised for HEAD when bound at HEAD~2. Tool path wraps violation as error string in orchestrator (line 308-309), not silent leak.

EC-2.evidence: tests/test_attribution_agent.py::test_stops_on_budget: InfiniteToolLLM exhausts max_tool_calls=3; report returns with budget_exceeded=True, no exception. When LLM emits ```suspects``` block, loop breaks before budget check on that turn (orchestrator lines 287-290), preserving suspects.

EC-3.evidence: Fully empty ProblemStatement(title='', description='') → is_empty True (test_empty_when_both_blank). Title-only with empty description → is_empty False, to_prompt_text returns '## Bug Report: {title}' without crash (test_no_description). Contract wording ambiguous; implemented behavior matches tests.

EC-4.evidence: Temp verification: git_blame_naive/file_history_recency on ProblemStatement('General bug', 'Something broke') → 0 suspects, no exception. EC-4 PASS.

EC-5.evidence: evaluate_attribution() on empty suspects: hit_at_1=False, mrr=0.0, evidence_grounding_rate=0.0 (grounding_rates empty → avg 0.0). aggregate_results([]) returns zeros without division. tests/test_eval_metrics.py::test_no_hit, test_empty PASS.

findings: BLOCKER (AC-10): run_eval.select_eval_cases() calls ProblemExtractor.from_jira_issue() incorrectly — runtime TypeError on any eval run with JIRA descriptions.
src/eval/forensics.py imports deleted V2 modules (commit_investigator.analysis.archetype, context.context_builder) — ModuleNotFoundError on import; forensics tooling broken post-archive.
eval_harness.py (~670 lines) remains full V2 six-dimension eval harness with Route enum and CommitInvestigationReport — not rewritten for V3 despite run_eval.py being the new runner.
project_domain.mdc lists analysis/report.py as report assembly stage; V3 pipeline actually emits BugAttributionReport from orchestrator.py — doc/impl mismatch.
GitContextProvider._enforce_bound() silently returns (no raise) when commit_id cannot be resolved (lines 105-106) — unresolvable refs skip bound check rather than deny.
select_eval_cases() and run_eval() lack integration tests; AC-10 bug undetected by 201-test suite.
_v2_archive/ modules still import pre-archive paths (e.g. commit_investigator.analysis.archetype) — archive is reference-only and not importable without shims.
recommendations: Fix run_eval.py: extractor = ProblemExtractor(); problem = extractor.from_jira_issue(jira_issue, project=project). Add integration test for select_eval_cases() with mock JiraClient.
Archive or rewrite src/eval/forensics.py for V3 metrics; remove broken V2 imports.
Either rewrite eval_harness.py for V3 or mark deprecated and redirect to run_eval.py.
Align project_domain.mdc report assembly with BugAttributionReport (or add V3 report module).
Harden _enforce_bound: deny access when commit cannot be resolved under a temporal bound.
Add smoke test: run_eval main() with --n 1 against fixture zip/repos (mock LLM) to catch orchestration regressions.

rubric_notes.code-quality: V3 modules are well-structured with clear types, docstrings, and focused tests. Main quality gap is insufficient integration coverage of the eval runner hot path (select_eval_cases bug). Residual V2 code in eval_harness.py and forensics.py creates maintenance confusion.
rubric_notes.architecture: Clean V3 pipeline separation (ProblemExtractor → AgentOrchestrator → eval_metrics) with temporal bound at GitContextProvider boundary. LLM-reasons/scripts-verify principle honored. Weakness: dual eval paths (V2 eval_harness vs V3 run_eval) and stale forensics tooling break architectural coherence post-pivot.
